hook.title: Make the AI *check its own work*

scenes.before: Write a cover letter for this job.
scenes.after:
Write a cover letter for this job.
Then check it against the 3 requirements in the posting and fix anything that misses one.
scenes.title: Add a *review* step
Give it a *checklist*
scenes.body: Requirements, a rubric, a style guide. Something concrete to check against.

scenes.title: Ask what it *guessed*
scenes.body: "List anything you weren't sure about." The weak spots show up fast.

end.title: Save this *one*
end.sub: follow for daily AI + code tips

caption:
First drafts from AI are first drafts. Build the review into the prompt.

Give it something concrete to check against (the job's requirements, a rubric, a style guide) and tell it to fix anything that misses. Then ask what it guessed at. You'll know exactly what to double-check.

Save this for your next big draft.
